author: bencos18 (492089091320446976)
name: UsageStats
short: See how many people use your bot and which commands they run.
description: Logs every prefix and slash command from every cog to a small SQLite file and shows usage by day, week, month, year or all time: commands run, unique users, servers, top commands, cogs and servers.
install_msg: Thanks for installing UsageStats! It starts counting straight away. Owners can run `[p]usage` (or `/usage overview`) to see the numbers.
end_user_data_statement: This cog logs which commands are used: the time, the Discord user ID, the server ID and the command name. It is only used for usage counts, kept for about 400 days, and deleted on a data deletion request.
